title: The AMetric Boundary as a Unique Regime-Invariant Constraint on Admissibility-Bearing Construction
description: Establishes the unique, non-parameterized AMetric boundary for admissibility-bearing, identity-preserving construction. Relabelling cannot supply a privileged target, ranking or graded geometry before fixation. The boundary is non-eventful and non-transmissive; metric descriptions belong to licensed interiors. The result is a fixed-domain structural theorem, not a causal creation process or an empirical model of all physical systems.
keywords: AASC, AMetric boundary, Kernel of Admissibility, premetric foundations, identity-preserving construction, no-selector theorem, relabelling invariance, standing, fixed-domain exhaustion
